data.gender_notes: Awaisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘awwāsha’, meaning ‘bird’. In Islamic culture, the bird is a symbol of freedom and light, representing the soul soaring towards the heavens. The name Awaisha carries the meaning “Bird, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awaisha usually hope their child will grow to embody bird, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awaisha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir wrote in 'Al-Bidayah Wan-Nihayah' that Aisha bint Abu Bakr was born in Makkah and was the third wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and she played a significant role in spreading Islam during the early years.
